messages:
tara: Thanks for a solid all-hands — starting a follow-up thread for the GTM / sales pipeline / partnerships section so we can track owners. I'll ping people and collect links here.

mohit: two quick asks: 1) can we get the raw partner-sourced pipeline CSV? 2) what's the expected close window for the 5 deals shown as "late-stage"?

lina: CSV will be shared from SFDC view (partner_tag = true). Mohit, expect it by EOD. For the five deals, estimated close months are Apr, May, May, Jun, Jun (probabilities in the CSV).

tara: appreciated. put access perms to "g-team-sales" only for now.

vijay: small clarification on channel conflict: if a partner originates and an internal AE also sources the lead, which motion do we credit? need the rule asap for commission planning.

cass: short rule proposal: partner-originated if first touch is via partner contact OR partner lead id exists in SFDC. If both occur, partner gets primary credit; internal AE gets secondary. Feedback?

mohit: that aligns with comp ops memo. can we finalize by Friday so payroll can reflect for next month?

lina: we'll loop comp-ops and legal to make sure contract language matches.

tara: another ask from product: are there prioritized use-cases for co-marketing assets? we should surface the top 3 so marketing can build templates.

vijay: top three per GTM: 1) joint case study for security/regulatory wins, 2) partner integration tutorial + demo, 3) short ROI one-pager for finance buyers.

cass: marketing note: can we get customer names approved for case studies? partner legal often needs signoff.

tara: action: @cass to draft the case study template and share for approvals. @lina to compile the shortlist of customers that are ok to contact.

mohit: roadmap question: when will the partner portal (for co-sell assets) be live? AEs want link in week of Apr 6.

lina: current ETA is Apr 12. We can soft-launch a partner drive with templates by Apr 6 if marketing can host interim assets.

tara: interim drive sounds fine. @cass please confirm by Tue.

vijay: forecasting detail: are partner-influenced deals treated differently in MQL -> SQL velocity? our data shows longer cycles but higher ACV. should we use a separate forecast category?

mohit: suggestion: flag partner-influenced as a sub-bucket in the forecast model so CRO can see velocity and ACV delta. Ops can add a column in the weekly forecast export.

lina: ops will add the column. I'll attach a mini doc with definitions (in-channel) once ops confirms.

ops-bot: Recording + slides: All-Hands 2026-04-01 (https://redwood.app/records/ah-2026-04-01), slides deck (https://redwood.app/slides/ah-2026-04-01)

cass: last one: for joint webinars, what is the lead routing SLA? Sales wants leads routed to AEs within 4 hours. Partner PMs ask for 24h for qualification. can we pick one?

tara: compromise: route raw leads to AE queue within 4 hours, but tag with partner and assign a 24h qualify reminder to partner PMs. that keeps AEs responsive and keeps partner engaged.

mohit: thanks, that works. please document in the partner ops playbook.

lina: summarizing actions: 1) SFDC partner CSV shared (Lina) 2) finalize channel-credit rule + comp loop (Cass/Lina/Comp-Ops) 3) case study template + customer shortlist (Cass/Lina) 4) interim partner drive + portal ETA (Cass/Lina/Product) 5) forecast sub-bucket + export column (Ops) 6) lead routing SLA docs (Sales Ops). I'll drop the doc links here when ready.

tara: perfect. I'll consolidate into a single doc and tag owners. Reopen thread if anything missing. Thanks all!
